technical_quality: Adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the heart); minimal rotation; low lung volumes / poor inspiratory effort with both hemidiaphragms high; apices and both costophrenic angles included; bilateral shoulder prostheses project over the shoulders only and do not obscure the lung fields. No L/R marker seen; conventional orientation assumed.

devices.type: Right shoulder arthroplasty (stemmed humeral head prosthesis with glenoid component)
devices.location: Right shoulder, patient's right, projecting outside the right upper lung zone

devices.type: Left shoulder arthroplasty (reverse-type appearance: glenosphere with humeral cup)
devices.location: Left shoulder, patient's left, projecting outside the left upper lung zone

devices.type: Small ring-shaped metallic external artifact, most likely an earring
devices.location: Patient's left head/neck region, projected above the thorax at the top of the film (image top right)

devices.type: Tiny linear metallic/calcific density (~0.3 cm), possibly a small surgical clip vs calcified node - uncertain
devices.location: Medial right hilar / right paraspinal region, right middle zone

abnormalities.finding: Elevated right hemidiaphragm, dome about 2.5 cm higher than the left, smooth contour with central peak (no lateral peaking to suggest subpulmonic effusion); reduced right basal lung volume. Right heart border partially obscured by the high diaphragm.

Rounded retrocardiac soft-tissue opacity (~4-5 cm) with curvilinear wall and central lucency projecting behind the left heart just above the left hemidiaphragm, most consistent with a hiatal hernia; gastric fundal gas seen below the left hemidiaphragm.
Tortuous / unfolded descending thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob (mediastinal contour, no discrete mass).
Low lung volumes with crowding of basal bronchovascular markings; no focal consolidation, nodule, or interstitial pattern.
Mild thoracic spine curvature (mild scoliosis / slight rotation).
Tiny linear dense focus near the right hilum, possible surgical clip vs calcified granuloma (indeterminate).

description_zh: 胸部正面X光（疑似PA立位），吸氣量不足、雙側橫膈位置偏高，右側橫膈明顯高於左側約2.5公分，呈平滑圓頂狀，右下肺容積減少，雙側肋膈角尚清，未見氣胸或明顯肋膜積液。心臟後方、左側橫膈上方可見一約4-5公分之圓形軟組織影，具弧形邊緣及中央透亮區，最符合食道裂孔疝氣；胸主動脈迂曲、主動脈弓突出，心臟大小在正常範圍，肺野未見實質浸潤或結節。雙側肩關節置換術後（右側含關節盂組件、左側疑為反式人工肩關節），左側頭頸部投影處有一環狀金屬異物（疑為耳環），右肺門內側另見一極小線狀高密度影（疑為手術夾或鈣化），胸椎輕度側彎。
